edition: Returns by year: calendar 1928–2025, as retrieved

source_notes.us_stocks: S&P 500 annual nominal total return including dividends; pre-1957 backfilled index history.
source_notes.us_bonds: Annual nominal total return of reconstructed constant-maturity 10-year US Treasury, including coupon and price changes; not an aggregate-bond index or ETF.
source_notes.usd_cash: Annual 3-month Treasury-bill rate proxy; provider uses annual average rates. Not a bank deposit or money-market-fund return series.
source_notes.us_cpi: FRED CPIAUCNS December index / preceding December index - 1; not the workbook inflation column
source_notes.us_home: US home-price appreciation from provider Shiller/Case-Shiller history; excludes rent, modeled separately.

coverage_note: US annual series use observed NYU/FRED history. Observed China CPI and year-end USD/CNY supply calibration references; configured AR(1)/FX parameters generate future paths. Medical growth, distribution yields and property-specific adjustments remain assumptions.

us_cpi_source.convention: December CPI / preceding December CPI - 1; not seasonally adjusted

status: Observed annual references bundled; raw-cell fidelity and independent population calibration checked; provider methodology and legal rules remain separate
historical_source_status: CHECKED: 392 NYU return cells and 98 FRED December-to-December CPI rates; 98 consecutive joint years

conventions.CPIAUCNS: US CPI, all urban consumers, not seasonally adjusted: December index / preceding December index - 1. Bundled annual series 1928–2025.
conventions.FPCPITOTLZGCHN: World Bank China annual-average inflation, source percent divided by 100. Reference history 1987–2025; calibration 1997–2025; future paths still use configured AR(1) parameters.
conventions.DEXCHUS: CNY per USD: last valid observation of each calendar year, 1981–2025. Calibration log returns 2006–2025 require the 2005 baseline; future paths still use configured FX parameters.
